rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables LLMs to work with the Dossier automation standard, a structured instruction format (.ds.md files) for reproducible AI workflows. Provides tools for discovering dossier registries, verifying integrity through checksums and Ed25519 signatures, and executing multi-step workflows with built-in validation. Supports both local and remote dossier sources with JSON frontmatter-based configuration.
